title: Neminath ne apni baraat kyun wapas mod di?
hooks: Baraat chal rahi thi, achanak rath mud gaya.
Dulha mandap se pehle hi wapas kyun chala gaya?
Ek awaaz ne rajkumar ko sanyasi bana diya.
hook_why: Opens with the visual surprise of a wedding procession reversing — immediate kinetic curiosity, no setup, fits the 'raaz hook rule' (named entity + shocking action in first words).
metaphor: A golden chariot wheel slowly rotating in reverse, each spoke glowing as it turns — the moment compassion overrides duty.

cast.Neminath_idol: Serene marble idol of Lord Neminath in padmasana, half-closed eyes, dark bluish complexion, conch (shankha) emblem on pedestal, soft saffron glow around, ornate Jain temple backdrop
cast.Rajul: Princess Rajul in traditional bridal attire, calm composed face, hands folded, standing at palace window, soft golden light
cast.Charioteer: Elderly charioteer in simple dhoti, holding reins, respectful posture, weathered face
cast.Monk_Neminath: Neminath as a Digambar monk, sky-clad, standing in kayotsarga on Mount Girnar, vines gently around feet, peaceful radiance
